subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams Graph media fallback remain default-off/config-gated, or should the plugin automatically query Graph for non-personal HTML-only messages after direct media extraction fails?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the safe default affects Graph call volume, mention-only behavior, permissions expectations, and message-delivery compatibility for existing Teams deployments.

options.title: Default-off Graph fallback
options.body: Keep the fallback behind an explicit Microsoft Teams plugin config option and require docs/tests for fresh setup and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Automatic fallback
options.body: Enable the Graph query automatically for non-personal HTML-only messages and accept the extra Graph lookup cost as the bug-fix default.

options.title: Split channel and group-chat fixes
options.body: Land channel URL-shape repair separately from the group-chat fallback flag if maintainers want lower-risk sequencing.

recommendation.title: Default-off Graph fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the fallback behind an explicit Microsoft Teams plugin config option and require docs/tests for fresh setup and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Microsoft Teams plugin and channel-context commits make this the strongest available routing candidate for the fallback/default decision.
